subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: The Movable Pulley: Force Multiplier
description: One-minute skill: The Movable Pulley: Force Multiplier.

hook.text: Attach the pulley to the load instead of the ceiling and suddenly you only need half the force to lift it.

buildup.text: A movable pulley splits the load between two rope segments. Each carries half the weight.

discovery.text: Mechanical advantage is 2. You pull twice the rope length but need only half the force. Same trade-off.

twist.text: Sailors discovered this centuries ago. Moving pulleys let small crews raise massive sails.

climax.text: Combine fixed and movable pulleys into a block and tackle for even greater force multiplication.

punchline.text: Move the pulley to the load and physics does half the work.

quiz.question: What is the mechanical advantage of a single movable pulley?
options: 1 — it only changes the direction of force
2 — it halves the force needed but doubles the rope pulled
4 — it quarters the effort required to lift a load
